user.title: Assist Utils
user.description:
Utilities for voice assistants. Voice commands are handled before any conversation agent, including LLM agents, so they cost no LLM call.

Choose the languages whose default phrases should be loaded. You can edit the phrases afterwards in the integration options.

data_description.features: Turn off anything you don't want; you can change this later.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Assist Utils is already set up.

features.title: Features
features.description: Choose which features are active. Turned-off voice commands stop listening for their phrases, and turned-off buttons are removed.

data_description.languages: Default phrases are loaded for these languages. Phrases you customized are kept.

reset.title: Reset conversation
reset.description:
Clears the current conversation's history, so the next request starts a new conversation. Useful when an LLM keeps repeating an earlier mistake.

One phrase per line, without punctuation. [word] is optional, (a|b) means either. Matching ignores case but not accents, so list both spellings if your speech-to-text is inconsistent. Clear the field to go back to the defaults.

cancel.title: Silent cancel
cancel.description:
Ends the request without a response and without calling the conversation agent. Use it when the wake word triggers by mistake.

One phrase per line, without punctuation. [word] is optional, (a|b) means either. These phrases take priority over built-in commands, so a bare "stop" no longer pauses media. Clear the field to go back to the defaults.

data_description.also_reset: Clear the conversation history as well, so the false wake doesn't stay in the LLM's context.

options.satellite_buttons: Reset conversation button on each satellite

reset_conversation.name: Reset conversation
reset_conversation.description: Clears Assist conversation history so the next request starts a new conversation. Target satellites to reset their conversation, give a conversation ID, or leave both empty to reset all conversations.

conversation_id.name: Conversation ID
conversation_id.description: Reset this conversation, for example the trigger.user_input.conversation_id of a sentence-triggered automation.
